source: Notre Dame and NBC Extend Media Rights Agreement To 2029 (Front Office Sports)
notes: Article estimates ND's new total annual payout at ~$50m/yr, combining a football-only NBC figure (roughly double the prior ~$20m/yr = ~$39m/yr) plus ~$11m/yr in ACC other-sports revenue (ND's non-football sports play in the ACC). Only the ~$39m football-specific estimate is included here; the ~$11m ACC-sports portion is excluded from this football total (it is a small part of the ACC number above's remainder, not separately added, to avoid double-counting).
